### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>onsi/gomega (github.com/onsi/gomega)</summary>

### [`v1.44.0`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/releases/tag/v1.44.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/compare/v1.43.1...v1.44.0)

##### Fixes

- `BeNumerically` compares signed and unsigned integers by value: `-1` no longer equals `uint64(math.MaxUint64)` and `uint(5)` is now greater than `-3` ([#​925](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/issues/925)) \[[`26e3c6b`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/26e3c6b)]
- `BeNumerically("~")` no longer overflows when computing the distance between extreme integers ([#​928](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/issues/928)) \[[`1955764`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/1955764)]
- `BeNumerically("==", x, threshold)` now honors the threshold for floats, as it already did for integers ([#​927](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/issues/927)) \[[`10e2aca`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/10e2aca)]
- `HaveKeyWithValue` succeeds if any key accepted by the key matcher has a matching value, rather than depending on map iteration order ([#​929](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/issues/929)) \[[`ffc577a`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/ffc577a)]
- `HaveKey` and `HaveKeyWithValue` treat key and value matcher errors like `ContainElement` does: a match wins, and an error is only reported when nothing matches ([#​926](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/issues/926)) \[[`dc91598`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/dc91598)]
- `MatchJSON` no longer treats numbers too large for a float64 as equal to one another ([#​930](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/issues/930)) \[[`9d619a5`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/9d619a5)]
- `MatchJSON` compares integers beyond ±2^53 exactly, so neighboring large integers (e.g. IDs) no longer match; all other numbers are still compared as float64s ([#​931](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/issues/931)) \[[`8ef1aa7`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/8ef1aa7), [`630fe12`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/630fe12)]
- `HaveExactElements` reports missing or extra elements that start at index 0, and reports the first extra element's index rather than the last ([#​934](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/issues/934)) \[[`af1b777`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/af1b777)]
- `MatchYAML` compares every document in a multi-document stream rather than only the first; empty documents (e.g. a leading or trailing `---`) are ignored ([#​933](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/issues/933)) \[[`2773796`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/2773796)]
- `MatchXML` ignores namespace prefixes: elements and attributes are compared by namespace URI, and the URIs declared on each element must match whatever prefix they are bound to ([#​932](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/issues/932)) \[[`c0dbd89`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/c0dbd89), [`2565350`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/2565350)]

</details>
